title: EasterEgg Mod (LuckyEgg Mod)
description: This is a Reupload of a Old Minecraft Mod for Preservation
body:
Author: SwedenGamers

Original Description: This is a mod that adds Easter Eggs to minecraft right now it's 16 different eggs and more will be added. The eggs can be found all over the world and when you break a egg it will drop 1 item and it has 50+ different items it can drop. If you shift right click the block with a empty hand you can pick up the egg and use it as a decoration for your house.
